title: Pong arcade machine
alt: A Pong arcade machine in a museum: a tall wooden cabinet with a yellow front, the word PONG above a small screen, two round knobs for the players, and a metal coin slot lower down. Allan Alcorn's signature is written beside the name.
author: Chris Rand
description: Pong cabinet signed by Pong creator Allan Alcorn in the 'Golden Age of Video Games' exhibit at Neville Public Museum in Green Bay, Wisconsin.
